title: Plump Raisin Bran Muffins
summary: Dark molasses bran muffins packed with plumped raisins, made with plain and wholemeal flour and melted butter.
equipment: paper muffin cases or butter for greasing

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly

steps.title: Plump the raisins
steps.text: Pour the boiling water over the raisins and leave for 10 min. Drain well and pat them dry with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line or grease the 12-hole tin.

steps.title: Soak the bran
steps.text: Mix the bran and buttermilk in a large bowl and leave it while you weigh everything else.

steps.title: Mix the dry
steps.text: Whisk both flours, the bicarbonate, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg in the second bowl. Toss in all but a small handful of the raisins so they are coated in flour.

steps.title: Mix the wet
steps.text: Whisk the egg, brown sugar, molasses and melted butter into the bran.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Fold the dry mix into the bran with a spatula only until no flour shows.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spoon the batter into the holes and press the reserved raisins into the tops.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 18-22 min, until risen and a cocktail stick in the centre comes out clean apart from smears of raisin.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Leave in the tin for 5 min, then move to the rack.

tips: The most common mistake is adding the raisins wet; pat them dry and coat them in flour or they sink to the bottom.
Overmixing makes tough muffins; stop as soon as the flour disappears.
For a citrus note, add the finely grated zest of an orange with the wet ingredients.
Warm leftovers for 10 seconds in the microwave.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
